# TASK-015 Report job cadence

Status: ready

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence the business wants.

## Notes

- Issue #31 (opened in May) says: "make the report job run weekly".
- The current value is in src/report_job.js.

## Cadence decision

Selected: `daily`, every day at 06:00 shop time.

The accepted ADR 0004 in example/mira-decisions sets this cadence and
supersedes ADR 0002's weekly cadence. Issue #31's May request is outdated.
The current `weekly` value in src/report_job.js still needs to be updated;
this task remains ready for implementation. This session records the decision
only, as requested.

Reference (verified in the local decision log on 2026-10-21)
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0004
  Path           docs/adr/0004-reports-go-out-daily.md
  Commit         39f397435a078f1a86db014e9eae952a96e0e20e
  Digest         sha256:3e0eadfd7e9a4678b313052fcf6070c20f109c4d241f83ee8804d0a8352a83ea

## Delivery request

On 2026-10-21, Mira said: "Please get this one done today."
Requested completion date: 2026-10-21 (Asia/Taipei).
This is a delivery deadline; the cadence follows ADR 0004 above.
